blurb: Soul Fire Brewing Company brews beer with Texas spring water, whole grain, and whole flower hops. The kitchen offers fresh pizza crust with generous toppings and homemade touches. The venue hosts weekly events including bingo, trivia, open mic, live music, comedy shows, and arcade tournaments.
